title: 2020 Leaf Draft - Gold #47 KJ Hamler (RC) - Penn State Rookie Football
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2020 Leaf Draft Gold parallel trading card featuring KJ Hamler, a rookie football player from Penn State. The card is part of the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) set and is numbered 47 in the collection. This sports trading card is manufactured by Leaf and includes various features such as being a rookie card and part of the base set.
